dataset: JPL SSD planetary satellite mean orbital elements

source.note: Elements are embedded in the page HTML (table id sat_elem). These are mean elements at epoch 2000-01-01.5 TDB and are approximate by design; secular precession of node and periapsis is not represented here. Values are copied verbatim from that table and stored as strings; parse to float in the app.

units.inclination_deg: degrees, relative to the stated reference plane per moon
units.laplace_pole_ra_deg: degrees (ICRF right ascension of the Laplace plane pole)
units.laplace_pole_dec_deg: degrees (ICRF declination of the Laplace plane pole)
units.laplace_tilt_deg: degrees (tilt of the Laplace plane with respect to the planet equator, per source legend)

moons.name: Moon
moons.inclination_reference_plane: mean ecliptic (per the source frame legend for this row)
moons.frame_note: The Moon row uses the ecliptic frame in the source table, not a Laplace plane; the pole columns are blank in the source.
